notes.title: Demo Update (02/02/2024)
notes.notes:
[u]DYSCHRONIA: Chronos Alternate - Dual Edition Demo Update Announcement (02/02/2024)[/u]

[b]Update Details[/b]
We have addressed issues that occur under specific conditions.

・Fixed an issue where AB inversion and window mode settings were not saved.
・Changed the window mode "Disabled" and "Enabled" options to "Window" and "Fullscreen" modes.
・Corrected an problem where, in the investigation log / inventory, even though the display was set for Xbox, it showed "L" and "R" instead of the correct "LB" and "RB."
・Fixed an issue where, with information in the second row, opening the spiderweb-type menu would cause the cursor to continuously register on the "appearance only" in the second row.
・Addressed a problem where, during key configuration for movement (up, down, right, left), assigning the same key, swapping them, and then selecting all four would result in the same key being chosen.
・Resolved an issue where configuring movement keys (up, down, right, left) did not affect the UI movement and it remained fixed as WASD.


This update contains minor fixes and improvements. Please make sure to update for the best possible experience. If you encounter any issues with the game, please kindly get in touch via Steam Community or send a message to our customer support!
